--- Page 5 --- SHI KYNTIEN Ka jingroi jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka shong shikatdei eh ha ka jingtip jong, ka ia ki jingshisha ba shong tynrai jong kiei kiei kiba ngi iohi, iohsngew, mad, sma ne ia kynduh man la ka sngi. Ha ki sla jong kane ka kitab,, ngi.
pyrshang ban batai ia.
kine ki jingshisha da ki rukom pynshong nia kiba jem ba wat u khynnah ruh u lah ban sngewthuh.
La donkam ban pyniaid ia ki jingthoh tang hapoh ki pid ba la'buh da ka Education Department jong ka Sorkar, kumta ba ki khynnah shongskul ki lah ban pule.
Kumta ryngkat bad ka jingpynmih jong ngi ia kane ka kitab, ngi pynkyntang ruh ia ka sha , ka .pateng ba dang seilung, ka ri, kaba long ka jingkyrmen jong ka lashai.
La katta ruh, ngim artatien ba wat kito kiba la iohi shuwa ia ka sngi u bnai ruh kin shem jingmyntoi lada kin pyllait por, khyndiat ban khyllied ia ki sla kane ka kitab.
Ka jingmyntoi kan long kaba kham janai lada ngin ia..pynbynraplangia“KI,,JINGTIP KYLLUM"' ba la kynshew ha kane ka kitab bad kito ki jong ki lai tylli kiwei pat ki kitab ba la kha synrop bad kane.
Kan da long ka jingmyntoi kaba khraw lada ki nonghikai kin' ialam ia ki khynnah sha ki jingshisha jong kiei kiei kiba ia dei peitthuh; ,ka ban kyrsiew, bad ,ktik.
ia ka jingkwah tip shuh shuh ia kiei kiei kiba don sawdong kiba ki ia kynduh barobor ha ka --- Page 6 --- ii jingim jong ki. Katba lah, lum ia ki jait khynnah hi.
Ha ki aiom aiom pynmlien ia ki'ban peitthuh ia ki jingthung 'ki soh ne kumno 'ki long, ki man, bad ki kharoi.
Iarap ia ki ban mlien.
pyndonkam ha, la ka jingim ia kiei kiei ba ki la nang bad tip bad ban ym hun tang ha ka tip.
Namar ka jingkhim ka por ha kaba ngi la hab ban pynmih ia kine ki kitab, ngi la hab shon kyrkieh ia ki.
Ka lah eh ban long ba ki jingduna ne jingbakla kin.

paw hangne hangtai; ia kine, ngi kyrpad ba ki nongpule ba sbun kin mab., Ngi pdiang., sngewbha ia kino kino ki jingkynthoh ne jingai jingmut lem jong phi ki nongpule, ki ban iarap ban pynbha shuh shuh ia kane ka jingpyrshang kaba rit.

Khatduh iawai, ngi ai khublei ia kito ki paralok  baroh, kiba .ngin ym, lah ban niew kyrteng lut hangne, kiba la ia don kti lem --la khyndiat ne shibun -- ha ka ban , pynkylla ia kane ka jingphohsniew sha ka jingshisha.

76 --- Page 9 --- 1.KI PLANET KUMNO BAN ITHUH IA KI Ha ka Kitab kaba Ar, ngi la .pule shaphang ka kynhun planet jong ngi bad ia ki jingjngai jong uwei uwei u planet na ka Sngi.
Ha kane ka lynnong ngin pyrshang ban kdew kumno ngi lah ban ithuh lada ngi peit ia ki ha sahit bneng ha ka miet ba shai bha ka bneng.
U planet uba jan eh ia ka Sngi u dei u Mercury.
U long ruh ,uba rit tam na ki planet baroh.
Ngim ju iohi koit ia u namar u ia bud ryngkat ryngkat bad ka Sngi.
Ngi lah ban iohi ia u tengkhat, hadien ba ka Sngi ka la sep ne shuwa ba kan mih. U Venus u kham jngai ban ia u Mercury na ka Sngi.
Une u planet u dei u met bneng uba phyrnai bad uba itynnat tam ha sahit bneng.
Ngi lah ban iohi ia u kum u 'Lur Step shaphang mihngi ha ka por kynjat shai bad kum u' 'Lur Miet shaphang sepngi hadien ba la sep ka Sngi.
U Venus u heh lajan kat ka pyrthei hi.
U planet uba lai dei ka Pyrthei jong ngi.
Hadien ka Pyrthei bid sa u Mars.
Une..
u Mars u kham rit khyndiat ia_ ka Pyrthei., Ia une u planet ki ju khot ruh u Planet Meh Ding, namar ka jingshai jong u ka lam byrsaw, kum ka, ding.
Lada ngin peit ia u da ki dorbin kiba khlai ngin iohi ba don ki dak ha u, kiba lieh bad kiba iong. Ngim pat lah ban ong thikna kine ki dei kiei.
Don kiba tharai ba don briew kiba shong ha une u planet, hynrei ia kane ruh ngim pat lah pynshisha.
--- Page 10 --- U Jupiter u long u planet uba phyrnai bha lait noh na u Venus.
U'heh khatlai shah ia ka Pyrthei bad u don 8 tylli ki bnai kiba shad tawiar ia u.
Don katto katne ki lyoh ha u, bad lyngba ki dorbin.
U planet ubai phylla eh u dei u Saturn.
Ym don uwei pat u met bneng kum ma u.
Lyngba ki dorbin ngi lah ban iohiia u ba u lam shaltuin khyndiat.
Sawdong jong u pat don lai ban ki ksah (rings) kiba ker tawiar ia u. Ka long kaba iphylia kumno kine ki ksah ki neh hi ha suin khlem jingkyrshan eiei na u planet.
Kine ki lah ban long tang ki lak bad ki phew lak ki bnai rit kiba shad sawdong ia u Saturn.
U Uranus u shad 10 kynta 45 minit ha la u jong u peiba (diameter) bad u, shim por 84 snem ban tawiar ia ka Sngi.
U Neptune u shad sawdong ia lade kumba 8 kynta bad u iaid tawiar ia ka Sngi shisien ha ka 165 snem.
U Pluto pat u shim por haduh 248 snem ban iaid tawiar ja ka Sngi namar ba u long uba jngai tam na ki planet baroh.
Ka long kaba kham shitom ban lap ia ka jaka ki planet --- khamtam naduh u Mars shaneng --ha ka sahit bneng shisien wad da ka khmat.
Ki, iing-peit-khlur (observatory) ki ju bneng man, ki por.
'Da kaba peit ia kine ki map, ngin kham, suk ban lap ia ki khlur ne planet ba ngi kwah ban iohi.
